title: A Glasshouse for the Undertow
author: U. M. Blackwood
blurb: Silas Halloran, a former prodigy returning to the conservatory as a janitor, has spent five years practicing the art of almost saying it. But when a childhood home goes up for auction, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must say goodbye properly, at last, out loud before the demolition date arrives.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
